correctness.rationale: A four-position witness attracts factors by zero-, one- and multiple-marker cases. The six-factor intersection constraints imply no three-point attractor. Length at most 18 implies k<=4; exactly 528 ordered distinct positive-gap vectors are fully enumerated, with two size-four words and 526 size-at-most-three words. Standalone exhaustive checker and a separate exact integer-programming formulation agreed. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Distinct-gap binary marker words are a natural structural class. The shortest threshold for losing the three-position attractor property reveals sharp dependence on gap order, with two reversal-related extremizers, an explicit obstruction, and a complete finite census. The statement is genuinely sharper than a single arbitrary word computation and has motivated relevance to compression invariants.
